about: A chip of BN5's whose code moved into BN6's engine (issue #82's C3): BN5's CanladEX held paralysed (hold: each game's own status step, the same bits in both) at (5,2), MegaMan with a folder of NrthWind D in both games, BN5's chip 138 by BN5's own code and the registry's 457 by the same code moved (BN5's support routine 0x15 as BN6's 0x3F), the first Custom screen's chip picked and OK, used at t30: every difference of BN6's play from BN5's fails it (docs/multirom/chips-code.md). NrthWind's gusts (the fourth kind's type 0x3A) are spawned by its wind (0x39) by a spawner no hook sees: MegaMan's (megaman_types).
subject: megaman
